en.title: The prefix catalogue
en.label: An isometric cutaway card catalogue. In cached mode, the front holder contains exactly k cached results; a feeler sweeps the candidate file when subtree scan is selected. A square clock shows average snapshot age.
en.aria: Click the front holder for cached top-k or a candidate file for subtree scan; clicking the feeler toggles lookup. Left/Right and Home/End choose the lookup; Space or Enter toggles it. Up/Down cycles metrics. Hover inspects the active read path; Escape returns the feeler.
en.caption: One open drawer represents a prefix node. In cached mode, its front holder has exactly k result cards; the accordion behind it represents the entire candidate file, not one card per candidate. Cached lookup reads only the holder; scan traverses the file. The clock tracks average snapshot age (half the rebuild interval). Cycle metrics to see read work, memory, age, and daily ranking entries from the lab.
en.description: {mode}: {count} candidates per query, {work} reads per second, {memory} MB top-k memory, {age} hours average snapshot age, {build} ranking entries per day.

id.title: Katalog prefix
id.label: Katalog kartu isometrik dengan laci terbuka. Dalam mode cached, wadah depan berisi tepat k hasil cached; alat pembaca menyusuri berkas kandidat saat scan subtree dipilih. Jam persegi menunjukkan rata-rata usia snapshot.
id.aria: Klik wadah depan untuk top-k cached atau berkas kandidat untuk scan subtree; klik pembaca untuk mengganti lookup. Kiri/Kanan dan Home/End memilih lookup; Spasi atau Enter menggantinya. Atas/Bawah mengganti metrik. Arahkan penunjuk untuk menelusuri jalur baca aktif; Escape mengembalikan pembaca.
id.caption: Laci terbuka mewakili satu node prefix. Dalam mode cached, wadah depan berisi tepat k kartu hasil; berkas berlipat di belakang mewakili seluruh kandidat, bukan satu kartu per kandidat. Lookup cached hanya membaca wadah depan; scan menyusuri berkas. Jam menunjukkan rata-rata usia snapshot (setengah interval rebuild). Ganti metrik untuk melihat pekerjaan baca, memori, usia, dan entri ranking harian dari lab.
id.description: {mode}: {count} kandidat per query, {work} bacaan per detik, memori top-k {memory} MB, rata-rata usia snapshot {age} jam, {build} entri ranking per hari.
